name: Seiko Epson Corporation
summary: Seiko Epson Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, sells, and provides services for products in the printing solutions, visual communications, manufacturing-related and wearables, and other businesses. The Printing Solutions segment offers home and office inkjet printers, serial impact dot matrix printers, page printers, color image scanners, dry-type office paper recyclers, commercial and industrial inkjet printers, inkjet printheads, POS systems, label printers, printer consumables, and digital printing software solutions.
